name: Coffee table, round Ø 80
notes: Generic example with typical sizes, not a specific product. Ø 80 cm and 42 cm high: a 3 cm solid oak top on four slim black metal legs (Ø 2 cm) that stand about 8 cm in from the edge. The surface for the table lamp and other small things is the largest square that fits on the round top (56 × 56 cm), so nothing put on it overhangs the edge. It has no clearance zone of its own; the seats around it carry their legroom.
